newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 12.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 12.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Thursday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Pop icon Michael Jackson, who will give a concert in Tallinn in August, will not stay overnight in Estonia and will not give any interviews.
- Estonia's Foreign Minister Toomas Hendrik Ilves shocked Russian journalists during a meeting in which he made what they regarded as startling comments on minority issues.
